'''Chief Superintendent''' was a title held by [[Lomeer]], an employee of the [[Viewpointe Residential Tower]] in [[Glare Peak]]. The Chief Superintendent was equipped with an ID, [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]], and overalls.<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak">''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''</ref>
